names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Εύσχημος ή Ευσχήμων ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Λαμψάκου», with the rank words left off. The line prints two forms, «Εύσχημος ή Ευσχήμων»; the head form is the one taken and the second is the one the English name follows.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 14 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети Евсхимон, епископ лампсакијски.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank, and with the see епископ лампсакијски left off as well. The heading gives no epithet, so the bare forename is what the source gives. saint.gr prints the Greek form two ways, «Εύσχημος ή Ευσχήμων»; the Serbian spelling is the second of those and is copied as the Prologue prints it.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 14 марта ст. ст., «Святитель Евсхимон (Евсхим) Лампсакийский, епископ, исповедник», with the rank words left off. The second form in the brackets is the link's own shorter variant and is kept with it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 марта ст. ст. — «Свт. Евсхимона исп., еп. Лампсакийского (IX).»

attestations.note: The ninth century the line closes with agrees with the reign of Theophilus, 829 to 842, that this folder already held from the Ohrid Prologue, and the life page behind the line names that same reign, so the interval is unchanged. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Εύσχημος ή Ευσχήμων ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Λαμψάκου»

attestations.note: The page dates him only by the persecution — «Έζησε στα χρόνια των εικονομάχων», he lived in the years of the iconoclasts — and gives no year, so this folder carries no dates. It has him denounced, exiled and imprisoned for defending the holy icons, spending on the poor even the money devout visitors brought him in exile, and says the Church justly numbered him among her holy confessors. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.03.2026 (14. март ст. ст.) — „Свети Евсхимон, епископ лампсакијски.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, and two sentences long: he bore persecution and imprisonment in the time of the war on the icons, and reposed in the reign of the iconoclast emperor Theophilus, whose years the entry itself prints as (829-842). The folder carried no date of any kind before this reading and now carries that reign as the interval for his repose, which is what BRIEF.md §3 does with a calendar that prints a reign rather than a year. The stored Serbian form is the bare forename: Свети is not a rank and епископ лампсакијски is the see, which this folder keeps in `office`. `sr-namesweep.mjs` returned no corpus folder for Евсхимон although this folder is the man — the alias table does not carry the Serbian spelling against the Greek Εύσχημος — and the identification came from the candidate file's menologion-day list instead. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue for the Julian 14 March: „Упокојио се у време цара Теофила иконоборца (829-842).“ The entry gives no year within the reign, so the interval is the reign it prints. saint.gr, which this folder was built from, gave no date at all.
